html.html: What is 66 rounded to the nearest ten?
What is 66 rounded to the nearest ten?

content.html: Find the place you want to round. Look one place to the right. If the digit is less than 5, round down. If the digit is 5 or higher, round up.

First, find the digit in the tens place. This is the place you want to round:

66


Now look one place to the right:

66


6 is greater than 5, so you will round up. First, replace all the digits to the right of the tens place by zeros:

66 → 60


Now add 1 to the other part of the number:

60 → 70
